responsibility: Contains focused unit tests for interpreter allocation internals, currently validating the `InitMask` byte-initialization tracking behavior across single-byte and range updates so changes to allocation initialization-state semantics are checked within the `mir::interpret::allocation` module.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the crate-root `tests.rs`, which is just a linkage workaround, and `util/common/tests.rs`, which checks a formatting helper, this `tests.rs` is scoped to the `mir::interpret::allocation` module and verifies allocation-specific `InitMask` initialization-range semantics.
